sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate verifies the missing stress, structural-member/web/flange, loading-condition, relationship, or buckling-readiness/evidence concepts. yieldStrength only represents the retained ship-owned MPa quantity, while vonMises is an xsd:string property and cannot support strict stress comparisons.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Replace the presence-only yield-strength readiness shape with the actual linear-calculation obligations. Retain yieldStrength as a ship-owned MPa decimal input, but locate canonical terms for linear-method applicability, web/flange calculation cases, nominal web shear stress, nominal flange von Mises stress, and buckling-criteria evidence.
